recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic profile of a man in a straw cowboy hat looking out through a rustic window frame at a vibrant firework display. The scene uses high-contrast lighting with warm yellow highlights on the subject and deep shadows in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in profile looking toward the right-side background
Diagonal window frame bars bisecting the composition
Explosive firework patterns filling the upper right quadrant
Warm interior light vs dark exterior night sky
coreInvariants: Diagonal structural lines of the window
High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the face
Vibrant orange and red firework bursts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile on the left third, extending an arm toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and hat, highlighted by a strong yellow light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's gaze on the left, following the diagonal window bars to the fireworks on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the lower-left and background sky provide breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm yellow and gold (highlights on subject)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the light sources against low-value, desaturated shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues except for small firework sparks
Maintain earthy tones in the foreground

characterSpecificRedesigns: A with a low horizontal crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, two-tone sans-serif for the artist name placed directly above the main title.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment with the subject's arm

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square geometric feel of the main title.
Provides the necessary horizontal presence and modern-industrial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a straw cowboy hat in profile, looking through a dark wooden window frame at night. The background should feature large, vibrant orange and red fireworks. Use strong yellow rim lighting on the man's face and hat.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, extended sans-serif text in white across the lower-middle section. Place a smaller line of text above it in yellow and orange. Ensure the text has a slight drop shadow to separate it from the subject's arm.

verificationChecks: Is the text wide and bold?
Are the fireworks vibrant against the dark sky?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and title text
Any specific logos or brand marks
The exact facial features of the individual

mustAchieve: Clear textural contrast between straw and metal/wood
Dynamic sense of celebration vs. quiet observation

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the complex background
Check that the lighting on the subject matches the implied light from the fireworks
Verify the diagonal composition creates a sense of depth
Confirm the typography feels heavy and grounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile subject + diagonal framing + high-contrast night lighting + extended bold sans-serif typography.
